comments.text:
Both of these are doable together only if you are a very studious individual , if you are an average student then it might be quite hard. Both of these faculties have high expectations and might be tough to manage together .
For msh3 , you cannot skip any classes may be 1 is fine . Alot depends on your attendance and you have to go through slides, more specifically memorise them. Everything in the paper will be from the slides but you have to memorise them and start from day 1. There are many chapters and they are also not very easy ( atleast not for an average student ) . You have to score good marks in your mid and quizzes.
For 318, this is one of the toughest courses of BBT so you have to be very mindful in class, take notes and try to understand concepts. You must study the book from day 1 as well because there is alot to cover, you have to understand and memorise at the same time . The slides are not at all enough if you want to score a good grade. They are just guidelines as to what you need to study from the book. Sir will inform you from day 1 that you need the book . Questions including quizzes are very conceptual . Quizzes are particularly hard so you have to study well but you might still not score great sometimes.
If you have other courses including these two it will be a nightmare for all so better drop one if you want to score good . If you have taken only these two courses then it is doable with all the suggestions above.
Now everything I have told you is from my personal experience ,also from experiences some others have had around me . However, there are people who have had better experiences and may have managed both together pretty well.It completely depends on what type of student you are and how you study.
Just tried to provide some genuine help from my own experience. All the best
